ture endpoint is covered. It uses a `MaxBodyBytes = 1024` constant. It reads at most 1025 bytes, so a chunked request with no declared length can't get past it. Requests with no body skip the check.

I added `TestBodyLimit` in `internal/api/api_test.go`, with three cases:

- A 1025-byte body to `/messages` returns 413.
- A 1025-byte body to `/health` returns 413. That endpoint ignores bodies, which shows the limit isn't tied to one handler.

One consequence is that an oversized body gets 413 even on a path or method that would otherwise 404 or 405.
